name: Shinjitsu no Princess
source:
Aquria, a small kingdom in the middle of the ocean. As you were leading a perfectly normal life..a Knight of the Royal Palace suddenly appears in front of you?!

“From today onward, you’re the Princess.”

And your life as the Princess suddenly begins. It’s always an exciting day at the palace with your fiance! But people begin aiming for your life... What will happen to the Princess’s romance when everything falls into place..

[From the [url=https://apps.apple.com/app/id1217730869]App Store[/url]]
translation:
Aquria，海洋中央的一个小王国。正当你过着正常的生活时……王宫骑士突然出现在你面前？！

“从今天开始，你就是公主了。”

你作为公主的生活突然开始了。和你的未婚夫在宫殿里度过的每一天总是令人兴奋的！但人们开始瞄准你的生活……当一切都步入正轨时，公主的浪漫将会发生什么……

[来自[url=https://apps.apple.com/app/id1217730869]App Store[/url]]
